parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ` format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description: The interval at which performance data is collected. Valid values: 5, 30, 60, 600, 1800, 3600, 86400, in seconds.

parameters.name: Key
parameters.description:
The performance metrics that you want to query. Separate multiple metrics with commas (,). For more information, see [Performance parameters](~~141787~~).

>  You can specify a maximum of five performance metrics.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ` format. The time must be in UTC.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb describe-db-cluster-performance --db-cluster-id pc-0000000000000000 --type orca --key PolarDBDiskUsage --start-time 2020-09-23T01:01Z --end-time 2020-09-23T01:00Z --interval 60 --sub-group-name example-string --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardb DescribeDBClusterPerformance --region cn-hangzhou --Type orca --EndTime '2020-09-23T01:00Z' --DBClusterId 'pc-0000000000000000' --StartTime '2020-09-23T01:01Z' --SubGroupName 'example-string' --Key PolarDBDiskUsage --Interval 60
